title: Emerald Circle
wikitext:
The '''Emerald Circle''' are a largely autonomous branch of the [[Cenarion Circle]] working specifically to undo the corruption in [[Felwood]]. They are stationed at the [[Emerald Sanctuary]] in southern Felwood.
